_doc: #4463 — what the team pays. The cost exporter (platform/scripts/cost-metrics) reads this; it lives beside the script, like borg-health-contract.json. Gemini prices from ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, read by Wren 2026-10-09; cached input is charged at the full input price (an upper bound).
